input:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 4x2 casino slot control atlas for SOVEREIGN TREASURY
Primary request: create exactly eight isolated physical controls in a perfectly regular 4 columns by 2 rows atlas: row 1 small home button with unmistakable luxury bank building icon, rules button with open engraved book icon, sound button with speaker icon, add-coins button with gold coin and clear plus sign; row 2 bet-minus small button with clear minus sign, bet-plus small button with clear plus sign, auto-spin button with two circular arrows, large spin button with one bold circular arrow
Style/medium: high-end commercial 3D casino machine controls, champagne-gold bezels, dark emerald glass faces, ivory enamel icon inlays, ruby micro accents, clean readable silhouette at 64 pixels
Composition/framing: exact 4x2 grid, one button centered per equal square cell, uniform scale and padding, spin button may be slightly larger but must remain inside its cell; no grid dividers
Lighting/mood: controlled premium casino reflections, no excessive glow
Text: only the required plus and minus mathematical signs; no words or letters
Constraints: perfectly uniform flat chroma-key magenta #FF00FF background edge to edge; no magenta on controls; exactly eight controls; every icon unmistakable; no watermark, cast-shadow rectangles, black square backplates, crop or overlap
Avoid: flat vector UI, generic emoji, detached labels, tiny illegible icons, sci-fi neon, heavy black shadows
